Hero MotoCorp Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held on May 05, 2016 has appointed  Mr Paul B Edgerley , Non-Executive Director of the Company as an Independent Director.w.e.f. May 05, 2016 subject to approval of the members of the Company.

Hero MotoCorp Limited has informed the Exchange that the meeting of Board of Directors ( Board )to be held on May 7, 2015. The Company wish to inform that the Board in its said meeting has considered and approved setting up of an operating wholly owned subsidiary ( WOS  ) in United States of America for conducting the business of, amongst others, providing research, development and consulting services, distribution, marketing and promotion of two wheeler vehicles, and any other ancillary activities. This could also entail purchase of assets for establishing the business. The Board has also approved the initial investment of up to Rs. 35 crores (Rupees thirty five crores Only) in the aforesaid WOS.

Hero Honda Motors Ltd. has informed the Exchange that in their board meeting held on May 30, 2006 : (1) Mr. Satoshi Toshida and Mr. Motohide Sudo, Directors on the Board have relinquished their respective office w.e.f. May 30, 2006 (2) Mr. Tasuhiro Oyama has been appointed as the Director in the casual vacancy caused due to resignation of Mr. Satoshi Toshida and Mr. Masahiro Takedagawa has been appointed as an Additional Director of the Company w.e.f. May 30, 2006.
